comments.body:
Just found a "fix", not sure if it would be a correct fix.

On xformers/triton/vararg_kernel.py, change

`jitted_fn.src = new_src`

to

```
jitted_fn._unsafe_update_src(new_src)
jitted_fn.hash = None
```

Then it works.

> Just found a "fix", not sure if it would be a correct fix.
> 
> On xformers/triton/vararg_kernel.py, change
> 
> `jitted_fn.src = new_src`
> 
> to
> 
> ```
> jitted_fn._unsafe_update_src(new_src)
> jitted_fn.hash = None
> ```
> 
> Then it works.

******************
Great it worked ! Thanks.
